summary: Verified the SIMPLIFIED 4-disease system (Brown Rust, Mosaic, Red Rot, Healthy) with UNet-only detection (no GPT/LLM). Backend: 44/44 pytest tests pass (6 new + 38 regression). GET /api/diseases returns exactly 4 keys; MR & HI translations applied. POST /api/detect returns disease from the 4-set + overlay_path with no LLM key needed. Frontend: admin login OK; Disease Library shows only 4 diseases; Admin Panel review dropdown has exactly ['Brown Rust','Mosaic','Red Rot','Healthy']; pending items render original + AI Overlay images; nav gating correct.

issues: 'DISEASES 10' stat is derived from legacy detection distribution in DB and does not reflect the simplified 4-disease system. Consider hard-coding to 4 or labelling as 'Detected Categories (all-time)' to avoid confusion.

action_items: (Low) Admin Panel 'Diseases' stat card shows 10 because disease_distribution aggregates historic detections still referencing removed diseases (Whiplash Smut, Pyrilla, Woolly Aphids, Eye Spot, Pokkah Boeng, Scale Insect). Optional cleanup: migrate/purge legacy detections OR return count of DISEASE_INFO keys only.
(Carryover from iter 3/4) RegisterPage inputs lack data-testids (register-username-input, register-password-input, register-submit-button).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (still >900 lines even after GPT removal). Recommend splitting UNet detection, auth, admin, and disease routers into modules.

/api/admin/stats.disease_distribution is a Mongo aggregate over all-time detections; it mixes legacy (26-disease) data with new 4-disease outputs. Consider filtering to DISEASE_INFO.keys() or exposing two counts (allowed_diseases_count vs historic_categories).
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data (test users created via existing suite are prefixed TEST_user_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simplified 4-disease system fully verified. Endpoints: GET /api/diseases (?lang=en|hi|mr) returns exactly {Brown Rust, Mosaic, Red Rot, Healthy}. POST /api/detect returns disease from that set + overlay_path (pure UNet, no LLM key). Admin dropdown testid: review-disease-select (native <select>, 4 <option>s). Disease Library page renders 4 items. NOTE: legacy detections in Mongo still hold removed disease names; admin stats show a 'Diseases: 10' card from that historic aggregate — behavior expected per handoff, flagged as UI clarity issue only.
